name: Rooted Daisy Completion
definition: For $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$ and an ambient root $r$, set $D_r(C)=\bigcup_{c\in C}[r,c]$, the union of ambient cube intervals from $r$ to the concepts of $C$.
comments: The root may lie outside $C$. After reflecting $r$ to zero, this is downward closure of the support family.
